verdict.rationale: Docs show agents get GitHub App access to repos, manage repositories/branches/commits, and run in isolated environments where they "safely run code, install dependencies, and test changes," which together support autonomous environment setup. However, there's no explicit end-to-end walkthrough of an agent cloning a fresh repo and self-configuring a dev environment (e.g., detecting package managers, handling env vars/secrets), and no independent/hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit clone+dependency-install workflow narrative, independent verification of autonomous setup success, handling of complex/multi-language dependency configs.
